verdict.rationale: MX documents separate connectivity products, each retrieving a distinct data set. Instant Account Verification returns only account and routing numbers, Account Owner Identification returns name and address, and Account Aggregation (90 days) is separate from Extended Transaction History (24 months). This implies a developer can choose narrower data products rather than taking an all-or-nothing pull. However, nothing in the evidence describes end-user consent being scoped per product, or any explicit data-minimization or scope-selection controls. missing for 10: documented product-scoped consent/scope parameters in the Connect Widget or API, explicit data-minimization controls, consent revocation/management docs, independent corroboration.
